name: fabled_passage_fetched_land_taps_for_mana
notes: Printed: '{T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land.' The fetched Forest is a land with its own mana ability (CR 305.6, 113.6): with four lands it untaps and taps for {G}. Until 2026-11-06 a card put onto the battlefield from the library got no abilities (binding.py registered only cards that already had a record), so fetched and ramped lands made no mana; found reviewing r19's games.
